title: Volve field Daily Drilling Report DDR-TEST-00073 — wellbore not published in this release
source_system: Equinor Volve / public DDR release — Volve field Daily Drilling
excerpt:
00:00 - 00:15: Performed TBT for r/d casing tong
00:15 - 01:00: R/d casing equipment
01:00 - 01:15: Changed handling equipment to 5 1/2"
01:15 - 01:30: Performed TBT for m/u jet sub/torque tool BHA
01:30 - 02:00: M/u jet sub/torque tool BHA
02:00 - 03:00: RIH with jet sub/torque tool BHA from surface to 129 mmd. Took 6 ton weight. Unable to run torque tool into casing stump. Attempted to run into casing with and without rotation.
03:00 - 03:45: POOH with BHA and l/o same
03:45 - 04:45: Prepared 12 1/4" taper mill BHA
04:45 - 05:00: Performed TBT for m/u 12 1/4" taper mill
05:00 - 05:45: P/u and m/u 12 1/4" taper mill BHA
05:45 - 06:45: RIH on 5 1/2" DP and tagged top of casing cut at 126,3 mmd.
06:45 - 07:00: POOH with 12 1/4" taper mill change of plans to avoid overtorqueing tie-back adapter during milling.
07:00 - 08:00: L/d 12 1/4" milling BHA
08:00 - 09:00: Discussed situation with land organization meanwhile prepared 9 1/2" taper mill
09:00 - 12:00: Prepared plan for dressing off top of casing. P/u CH mill and b/o stab. M/u assy and l/o. Rearranged pipe in derrick to access over-torqued pipe in set-back.
12:00 - 12:30: Performed TBT for dressing off top of cut. Meanwhile performed drops check on TDS.
12:30 - 14:30: P/u and m/u 9 1/2" taper mill BHA
14:30 - 15:00: RIH with milling BHA from 43 mmd to 120 mmd.
15:00 - 15:30: Filled pipe and established circulation 200 LPM 7 bar. Up/down weight 78/74 ton. Tagged top of casing cut at 126 mmd with 5 ton.
15:30 - 18:15: Rotated pipe 15-20 deg and passed restriction. Worked string up/down without flow and rotation several times. MAX overpull 15 ton. Overpull decreased to 0 ton after working up/down repeatedly.
18:15 - 20:00: Pulled above cut. Staged up pumps to 2000 LPM and initiated rotation 60 RPM. Free rot. Torque 1 5 KNM. RIH slowly until torque increased. Increased rotation to 120 RPM. Milled off torque and continued RIH slowly until torque increased again. Repeated until entire taper mill pass

Milled off torque and continued RIH slowly until torque increased again. Repeated until entire taper mill passed through top of cut w/o taking weight. Worked up/down with flow and rotation several times to polish cut.

Measured gauge on mill, 9 1/2". Observed wear on upper part of taper mill. L/d milling BHA.

P/u and m/u jet sub/torque tool BHA.
RIH with jet sub/torque tool BHA. Esablished circulation prior to entering cut, 120 LPM. Tagged no-go with 6 ton at 143m. Released tie-back adapter by rotating 6,5 turn LH. Released at 11,7 KNM.
